patterns.dependency_update: Update devDependencies in package.json, then run npm install to update lock file
patterns.test_verification: Run npm test and npm run build to verify nothing breaks

existing_implementations.description: Project uses vitest 2.0.0 for testing with jsdom environment. Has test setup with Next.js mocks and integration tests.

vulnerability_details.description: Allows any website to send requests to the development server and read responses, potentially leaking sensitive information during development
vulnerability_details.mitigation: Update vitest and @vitejs/plugin-react to versions that depend on esbuild >=0.24.3
